communication_goal: 区分已批准的编辑与需要另行确认的操作。
image_prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Create ONE polished educational scene illustration, square canvas approximately 1024x1024. Pure solid BLACK background with crisp clean WHITE line art only. Minimalist adult stick-figure programmer with circular head, thin limbs and simple expressive face. The programmer is conversing with a recognizable official OpenAI six-loop interwoven knot logo floating nearby, drawn in white with black negative spaces; the logo itself represents the AI conversational partner and has no human body. EXACTLY ONE human programmer and ONE OpenAI logo. Single coherent scene, no panels. Restrained programmer comic aesthetic. Keep the main scene approximately x=180..820 and y=230..770 on a 0..1000 canvas. Leave generous empty black space at the top y<200 and bottom y>820 for later learning labels. Props named in the scene must be recognizable, complete and unobstructed. No colored elements, gradients, gray shading, photorealism, textures, glow. NO speech bubbles, letters, numbers, readable code, captions, watermark or other logos. The only brand symbol is the requested OpenAI knot. Scene: The stick-figure programmer stands at left of a simple desktop monitor on a small desk and points toward the monitor, while the white OpenAI knot floats at right. Show one LARGE unmistakable outlined folder icon centered on the otherwise blank monitor screen: its tab and folder outline clearly recognizable, with no letters or code. This visible folder icon represents the project directory discussed in the conversation, not a physical paper folder. Make the complete icon large enough for a local crop, with generous space around it. No other screen icons or props.

coverage_review.scope: V005 的逐词编辑与底图视觉核对完成；本专题其他计划卡未制作，不声称学习效果或手机端验收。

annotation_coordinate_system: [x_min, y_min, x_max, y_max]，左上角为原点，按最终 images/V005.png 宽高归一化至 0..1；由人工视觉定位。

image_review.summary: 通过：黑底白线单幅插画，一个成年火柴人和一个可辨认的白色 OpenAI 六环结标识，底图无对白文字。框仅围住显示器上的完整文件夹图标；项目目录身份由对白支持，不误认成实体纸文件夹。
